decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the core offer and appears only as a mention on the website, so its results are uncertain, but the expanding firm's slack and the long maritime project cycles favour keeping it rather than starting problemistic search.
The medical examination light builds on established competencies, has its own page and fits the institutional customer base, so with no sign of a shortfall against aspirations it stays.
The explosion-proof luminaire line extends the firm's core industrial business in a growing industry and likely meets aspirations, so dropping it would be unwarranted.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular established product close to the core offer, so expected performance meets aspirations and there is no trigger to drop it.
